summary.intent: Land a fix so the oracle comparator scores react/34 (an intersection of an object literal and an HTML-attributes family with omitted keys) as identical to the flat golden, then work out what remains in the project queue.
summary.outcome: A subagent delivered the comparator fix on PR #402 (commit ac8fb188) with passing checks except the pending Entire Gates approval; the assistant summarized the fix and laid out user actions, the running S4 task, and the queued S5-S8 work.

repo: The oracle comparator has a single enforcement point for the 'intersection left as written' case: `flattenedFamily` in apps/oracle/src/oracle-compare.ts.
caliper-norm.ts now carries {element, omitted} on the name; `Omit<htmlAttributes, ...>` folds its keys into `omitted`, and name comparison is unchanged.

The HTML-attributes member table (apps/oracle/src/html-attribute-members.ts) has 278 names for `div` only, copied from the react/14 golden, so it is not independent evidence. A drift test pins it to that golden.
Elements without a table (e.g. button, a) stay `less precise`, which is the safe direction.
Other intersection sites (tool-norm.ts, oracle-checker.ts, reference-*) build Norms and were intentionally left alone.
Validation commands: `just lint doc-check machete typos`, `just test-checker-lane`, `just test-construct`, `pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-oracle test`.
construct-suite/README.md keeps a 'today:' list of known-failing rows, which was trimmed to react/29 only.
The weekly oracle shares the comparator, but only rows where Caliper's output is an object plus an htmlAttributes family can move.
PR #401 (gate harness and measurements) has merged to main. The Entire Gates check needs user approval.

code.finding: `flattenedFamily` implements the rule: an object literal plus one recognized HTML-attributes family is identical to a flat golden when the golden's members equal own members plus family members minus omitted keys. A member the golden lacks gives `wrong`; extra golden members or an omitted key still present stay `less precise`.
Six new cases cover the rule. With the src change stashed, 2 of 43 tests failed (equivalent case and missing member), and all 43 pass with it restored.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output without user authority, so the assistant verified PR state with `gh pr view` before summarizing.
Slice work is queued serially (S4, then the bigint PropType change, then S5-S8) to avoid conflicts in crates/core and convert.rs.
Clean-room verification at the commit (frozen-lockfile install plus test lanes) was used to confirm the fix.

friction: The Entire Gates check is pending and needs user approval before #402 can merge.
The subagent could not confirm that `tsc -p tsconfig.json` includes apps/oracle, so no separate typecheck was verified.
